basis.governing_question: What is the current state of patient waiting times at Norte Hospitals Group's three hospitals, and what drives them?

sub_questions.question: How long do patients wait at each of the three hospitals, and at which steps of their visit?
What causes the longest waits in each hospital's patient flow and use of capacity?
Which causes of waiting are shared across the three hospitals and which are specific to one?
Which waiting-time improvement areas have the largest effect on waits, and what does each require?

drivers.evidence: patient waiting times at its three hospitals

work.unit: Site diagnosed on the floor (cost baseline, line observation, loss analysis)

phase_work.why: All three hospitals diagnosed, two at once, in two rounds; above the archetype's 3-6 weeks because no hospital is sampled.

sizing.levers: Running all three hospitals side by side, or diagnosing two and extending to the third from data, would bring the diagnostic within six weeks.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how long patients wait at each of the three hospitals and identify the causes behind the longest waits.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final diagnostic and choose which waiting-time causes to take forward?

architect_notes: Archetype performance_improvement is used for its Diagnostic only; its Implementation phase is dropped because the type is assessment only.
Diagnosing three hospitals two at a time estimates at 6 to 8 weeks; the stated six weeks holds only at the low end.
